description: This file provides endian conversion utilities for Redis, including functions to reverse byte order for 16, 32, and 64-bit integers, and test code for these functions.

methods.name: memrev16
methods.description: Reverses byte order of a 16-bit unsigned integer in memory.

methods.name: memrev32
methods.description: Reverses byte order of a 32-bit unsigned integer in memory.

methods.name: memrev64
methods.description: Reverses byte order of a 64-bit unsigned integer in memory.

methods.name: intrev16
methods.description: Reverses byte order of a 16-bit unsigned integer and returns the result.

methods.name: intrev32
methods.description: Reverses byte order of a 32-bit unsigned integer and returns the result.

methods.name: intrev64
methods.description: Reverses byte order of a 64-bit unsigned integer and returns the result.

methods.name: endianconvTest
methods.description: Test function for endian conversion utilities, prints reversed byte strings.
